name: ATOSS Software SE
summary: ATOSS Software SE, together with its subsidiaries, offers technology and consulting solutions for professional workforce management and demand optimized personnel deployment in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Netherlands, Romania, and internationally. It provides Crewmeister, a software solution for small businesses; ATOSS Staff Efficiency Suite and ATOSS Startup Edition, software solutions for time and attendance management and workforce scheduling for all sizes in all industries; and ATOSS Time Control, a software solution for time and attendance management, and workforce scheduling for small to medium-sized customers, as well as de-centrally organized clients.
